newsitem.title: USA: NPC Intl revolving credit increased.
newsitem.headline: NPC Intl revolving credit increased.

text.p: NPC International Inc said Thursday it completed syndication of a three-year revolving credit facility that increased its borrowing capacity to $175 million from $50 million.
The facility was syndicated by Chase Securities Inc with Texas Commerce Bank serving as administrative agent.
It said the facility will provide the company financial flexibility to aggressively pursue its Pizza Hut acquisition strategy and Tony Roma's restaurant development.
NPC said it completed the purchase of 60 units in Tulsa, Okla.; Topeka, Kan.; Fort Smith, Ark., and Jackson, Tenn., as a part of the acquisition of 126 units from PepsiCo Inc's Pizza Hut Inc.
The company said it received required approvals and expects to close on the remaining 66 units by the end of March. The acquisition was funded by the newly established revolving credit facility.
NPC International is the world's largest Pizza Hut franchisee. It operates 475 Pizza Hut restaurants and delivery kitchens in 11 states.
